title: HolonEmergence
description: The result of composing parts into a higher holon through SYN. Two gates: supplementation (leave-one-out, each part must contribute individually) and downward-closure (the safety-critical gate — no absorption of parts, no unaccountable coordination). A failed holon is returned as an unpromoted assembly with the failure reason on the audit surface.

admitted.description: True if both gates passed. False means the composition is an unpromoted assembly.

status.description: holon = admitted (genuine whole); assembly = failed gate (unpromoted).

oneOf.description: Failure reason on the audit surface when not admitted.

parts.description: Part identifiers that compose this holon.

predicate_a.description: Specific character preservation — no part absorbed with no remainder (anti-predator gate).

predicate_b.description: Trace sensibility — holon traces are sensible by parts (anti-capture gate).
